content:
I am delighted to share that I have successfully completed my One-Month Legal Internship at LEGILOOM(01 July 2026 – 31 July 2026).
During this internship, I had the opportunity to work on: 📚 Legal Research Writing
✍️ Article Writing
⚖️ Case Commentaries
📝 Drafting & Research Reports
This experience enhanced my legal research, analytical thinking, and drafting skills while giving me valuable exposure to practical aspects of the legal profession. I am grateful to the entire LEGILOOM team for their guidance, mentorship, and encouragement throughout this journey.
A special thanks to Mr. Badal Singh (Founder)and Nandini Singh Singh (Internship Coordinator) for providing such a meaningful learning experience.
Thank you to everyone who has supported me on this journey. The learning continues!
